verdict.rationale: Cekura's own marketing says it flags issues and automatically suggests fixes. Its docs describe LLM-powered judging that evaluates each call against plain-English criteria, plus AI generation of custom metrics tailored to the agent's purpose. These are real in-product AI analyses of the user's call data. However, the automatic fix-suggestion capability rests on a single homepage line with no dedicated documentation. Missing for 10: first-party docs describing the AI insight/suggestion feature and where it appears in the product, an explicit insights or summary view over observability data, and independent or hands-on corroboration that suggestions work.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Cekura flags issues → reproduces in simulation → suggests fixes automatically.
Instead of writing code, you simply describe what constitutes success in plain English, and the system automatically evaluates each call against your criteria.
Evaluate AI voice agent calls using natural language criteria with LLM-powered judging
We also support generation of custom metrics based on the user's voice agent purpose.
